_comment: 10 Hz triangle (period 0.1 s) - a FAST version for watching the sweep quickly (originally 1 mHz for the 20-minute ECM run; frequency raised to see the behavior faster). RAMP shape; for a ramp the duty_cycle is the rise SYMMETRY - 50 = a symmetric triangle (rises half the period, falls half), 100 = rising sawtooth, 0 = falling sawtooth. 4 Vpp on a 2.5 V offset -> a 0.5..4.5 V automotive-style sweep. INFinity load matches a high-impedance ECM input / 1 MOhm scope. NOTE: capture this with a SHORT scope window (e.g. configure_scope(..., duration_s=0.3) for ~3 cycles) - the ecm_20min config (10 S/s, 1200 s) would badly ALIAS a 10 Hz signal. Output stays OFF until output_on.
name: triangle_1mhz
